title: Container Bookings: confirming or declining a booking request
content:
## Policy clause
Every admitted Container Bookings request is answered by confirmation or decline within the tier's confirmation time limit, counted from receipt. A request that passes the booking request admission rules and the no-show record check is confirmed on the requested sailing when space and equipment are available. For tiers whose space is guaranteed, the request is confirmed on the requested sailing whenever it passes those two checks. For other tiers, a request for a fully allocated sailing is declined rather than confirmed on another sailing, because the choice of sailing is the customer's.

Confirmation fixes the vessel and voyage, the ETD and the three cut-offs (cargo, shipping instructions and verified gross mass) on the booking, and starts freight charging.

A request that fails eligibility, or that the customer withdraws before confirmation, is declined, and the booking shows the decline date as its cancellation date. A declined request carries no charge of any kind, and the cancellation and no-show fees never apply to it.

## Branching Q&A
**The request passed both checks and the sailing has space and equipment.** It is confirmed on the requested sailing.

**The request passed both checks, the tier's space is guaranteed, and the sailing is fully allocated.** It is still confirmed on the requested sailing.

**The request passed both checks, the tier's space is not guaranteed, and the sailing is fully allocated.** It is declined. It is not confirmed on a different sailing, since the customer chooses the sailing.

**The customer withdraws the request before it is confirmed.** It is declined, with the withdrawal handled as a decline; no cancellation fee applies.

**The request failed an admission check.** It is declined without any charge.

## Status view
| Starting status | Outcome | Resulting status | Charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| requested | confirmed | confirmed | freight charging starts |
| requested | declined or withdrawn | cancelled, with the decline date as cancellation date | none of any kind |
